task.task_name: Triage a personal auto collision claim
task.task_description: Review a reported two-car intersection collision, check the claim against the policy and available records, identify whether information is sufficient to move it forward, flag missing documents or possible coverage issues, and route it to the appropriate claims team for an adjuster’s review.

operational_subtasks.description: Review the policyholder’s account, vehicle and party details, damage photos, and other submitted materials to understand the reported collision and capture relevant claim facts.
operational_subtasks.effort_rationale: Assume one review per new claim and that the supplied materials are available together. Allow time to read and extract the key facts, without repeating their review during later checks.

operational_subtasks.subtask_name: Check policy and available coverage records
operational_subtasks.description: Compare the reported policyholder, vehicle, loss date, and collision circumstances with accessible policy and claims records; flag possible coverage issues without making a final coverage decision.
operational_subtasks.effort_rationale: Assume one policy and records check per claim. The estimate covers verification and noting apparent issues using the facts already reviewed, not a full coverage adjudication.

operational_subtasks.subtask_name: Compare collision accounts and available evidence
operational_subtasks.description: Compare the policyholder’s account with the other driver’s information, damage photos, and any police report or other relevant records accessible using the report number; identify material conflicts or corroborating facts.
operational_subtasks.effort_rationale: Assume one focused comparison per claim, with the report number and submitted materials available. The estimate covers incremental comparison and noting discrepancies, not a separate investigation or repeated review of all documents.

operational_subtasks.description: Determine whether the information and supporting documents are sufficient to move the claim into the usual process; identify missing or unclear items, including whether a repair estimate is needed at this stage.
operational_subtasks.effort_rationale: Assume one completeness assessment per claim. Allow a few minutes to evaluate the materials already reviewed and identify any specific gaps; absence of a repair estimate alone is not assumed to prevent triage.

operational_subtasks.description: Assess the available claim facts for reported injuries, conflicting accounts, signs of possible fraud, or complicated coverage questions, and determine whether specialist attention is indicated.
operational_subtasks.effort_rationale: Assume a brief screening for every claim using findings from earlier checks. This is an incremental triage assessment, not a separate fraud investigation or final coverage or liability decision.

operational_subtasks.subtask_name: Route claim and communicate triage findings
operational_subtasks.description: Send the claim to the usual claims team or the appropriate specialist team, communicating the key claim facts, possible coverage issues, information gaps, relevant conflicts, and reason for specialist referral when applicable.
operational_subtasks.effort_rationale: Assume one routing and handoff per claim. Allow time to select the destination and enter or communicate the concise findings already assembled; do not include downstream adjuster work or follow-up to obtain missing items.
